# AGENTS.md — mis-backend

<!-- Generated by mis-workspace ONBOARDING.md from the repo profile. This is now the repo's own contract, so maintain it here. -->

## Purpose

Laravel 12 API for the MIS project. It receives RFID card scans from the Arduino scanner firmware (`arduino-rfid-scanner`), records attendance, relays card UIDs to the admin UI for card→student assignment, and serves the admin SPA (`mis-frontend`) and the student/parent app (`mis-mobile`). The RFID flow is rebuilt identically to `enrollment/mis-be`. Generator output (`laravel/laravel` + `php artisan install:api`); staff auth, school years, students, employees, grade levels, programs, terms, sections enrollments, term rollover, and fee items, fee schedules, payment plans, discounts, assessments, payments and payment holds with promissory notes (billing), and subjects and curriculum, and the teacher role and rooms, and class schedules with conflict checks (academics) implemented.

## Ownership

Owner: a.baladon@qstrike.com. Part of the `mis` project — shared plans, rules and wiki live in the workspace and are linked here at `.claude/common/` and `.claude/diagrams/`.

## Local Contracts

- Stack: php / Laravel ^12.0 (Sanctum ^4.0) · DB: postgres (tests: SQLite `:memory:`)
- Layer chain (build order): migration → model → factory → request → resource? → controller → route → test
- Coding rules: `.claude/rules/rules-common.md`, `.claude/rules/rules-backend.md`. Both are binding.
- Implementation agent: `be-developer`. Auditor: `be-auditor`.
- Plans for this repo: `.claude/common/plans/active/<slug>/plan-be.md`
- Route groups: device routes at the `/api` root, public. Every admin route under `Route::prefix('mis')` → `/api/mis/...`, behind `auth:sanctum` + admin/registrar role middleware. Auth done (mis-1): `POST /api/mis/login` public; everything else in `/api/mis` behind `auth:sanctum` and four role groups plus an admin group (split in mis-19; the older bullets' "registry group" is admin + registrar): session `Role::EMPLOYEE_ROLES` (mis-22: admin, registrar, cashier, teacher; only `/user` and `/logout`); any-staff `Role::STAFF_ROLES` (`/school-years/get-active`, `/school-years`, `/grade-levels`, `/programs`, `/school-years/{id}/terms`, `/terms/get-active`); registry `Role::REGISTRY_ROLES` (students, sections, enrollments, assessment candidates/preview/create/reassess, `GET /payment-plans` and `/{id}`, and since mis-22 `GET /rooms`, `/rooms/active`, `/teachers`, `/teachers/active`, and since mis-23 `/classes` (4 routes) plus the three timetable reads `GET /sections/{id}/timetable`, `/teachers/{id}/timetable`, `/rooms/{id}/timetable`); billing-read `Role::BILLING_READ_ROLES` (`GET /assessments`, `/assessments/{id}`, `/assessments/{id}/history`, the four payment reads, the hold check `GET /payment-holds/check` and the holds list `GET /payment-holds`); payment-write `Role::PAYMENT_WRITE_ROLES` (record and void a payment, grant and cancel a promissory note); and `role:admin` for admin-only routes (since mis-22 also the 4 room writes). The teacher role is in no group but the session group, so a teacher-only user gets 403 on every other route (`TeacherAccessTest`, 116 routes).
- Scanner contract (frozen; identical to `enrollment/mis-be`, matches the firmware — change only together with a firmware change):
  - `POST /api/scan` — JSON `{"rfid"}` — attendance. Student by `rfid` (404 `{message}` if none); first scan of the day creates `student_attendances` `time_in` + `status=present`, later scans set `time_out`; uses the **active school year**. 200 `{student, attendance}`.
  - `POST /api/rfid/scan` — form `rfid=` — assignment relay. 403 `{status, message}` unless cache `rfid_channel_opened` is set (by `/api/mis/rfid/open`, 300 s); else broadcasts `AssignRfid` (`message` = UID) on public channel `rfid`.
  - UID = uppercase hex bytes joined by `:` (4, 7 or 10 bytes). Firmware sends no Accept header → the api group forces `Accept: application/json`.
  - `students.rfid`: string, nullable, unique.
- Staff auth endpoints (mis-1, `AuthController`): `POST /api/mis/login` JSON `{email, password}` → 200 `{token, user}` or 422 `{message, errors}` (an inactive account with the right password gets 422 `errors.email` "This account is deactivated." and no token, mis-5); `GET /api/mis/user` → 200 `{user}`; `POST /api/mis/logout` → 204, revokes only the current token. `user` = `UserResource` `{id, name, email, roles: string[]}`. No valid token → 401 `{"message":"Unauthenticated."}`; no staff role → 403 `{"message":"Unauthorized"}`.
- Entity `school_years` (mis-3, `SchoolYear`): `name` string unique, `start_date` / `end_date` date, `description` text nullable, `term_type` string `semester`|`trimester` default `semester` (mis-11; required on create/update; cannot change while the year has terms), `is_active` boolean default false (not fillable; changed only by set-active, at most one active row).
- School-year endpoints (mis-3, `SchoolYearController`): `school_year` = `SchoolYearResource` `{id, name, start_date, end_date, description, term_type, terms_count, is_active, created_at, updated_at}` (10 keys since mis-11; `terms_count` = number of terms, dates `Y-m-d`, timestamps ISO-8601). Status precedence 401 → 403 → 422 → 404; ids numeric (`whereNumber`), else route 404.
  - `GET /api/mis/school-years` (any staff role: admin, registrar, cashier) → 200 `{school_years: [school_year]}`, all rows, `start_date` desc then `id` desc.
  - `POST /api/mis/school-years` (admin) JSON `{name, start_date, end_date, term_type, description?}` → 201 `{school_year}` (`is_active` false) or 422 `{message, errors}`. Rules: name required, max 255, unique; dates `date_format:Y-m-d`, `end_date` after `start_date`; description nullable, max 1000; `term_type` required, `semester`|`trimester`. `is_active` in the body is ignored.
  - `PUT /api/mis/school-years/{id}` (admin) same body (unique ignores own row) → 200 `{school_year}`, `is_active` unchanged; 422; 404 `{message}`. With terms (mis-11): 422 `errors.term_type` when the type changes; 422 `errors.start_date` / `errors.end_date` when the new dates would leave a term outside (inclusive). With payment plans (mis-16): 422 `errors.start_date` / `errors.end_date` when the new dates would leave an installment due date outside (inclusive, inactive plans count).
  - `DELETE /api/mis/school-years/{id}` (admin) → 204; 422 `{"message":"The active school year cannot be deleted."}` for the active row; 404. Deleting an inactive year deletes its terms (FK cascade, mis-11). An inactive year with sections: 422 `{"message":"The school year has sections and cannot be deleted."}` (mis-12; the active-year message wins for the active row). An inactive year with fee schedules (mis-15): 422 `{"message":"The school year has fee schedules and cannot be deleted."}` (checked after the sections guard). An inactive year with payment plans (mis-16): 422 `{"message":"The school year has payment plans and cannot be deleted."}` (checked after the fee-schedules guard). An inactive year with student discounts (mis-17): 422 `{"message":"The school year has student discounts and cannot be deleted."}` (checked after the payment-plans guard). An inactive year with assessments (mis-18): 422 `{"message":"The school year has assessments and cannot be deleted."}` (checked after the student-discounts guard). An inactive year with curriculum entries (mis-21): 422 `{"message":"The school year has curriculum entries and cannot be deleted."}` (checked after the assessments guard).
  - `PUT /api/mis/school-years/set-active/{id}` (admin) → 200 `{school_year}` (`is_active` true, all others false, and any active term of another year cleared, in one transaction with 3 attempts); 404 changes nothing.
  - `GET /api/mis/school-years/get-active` (any staff: admin, registrar, cashier) → 200 `{school_year}` or `{"school_year": null}`.
- Entity `terms` (mis-11, `Term`): `school_year_id` FK (cascade on delete), `term_number` (1–2 for semester years, 1–3 for trimester years; unique per year), `start_date` / `end_date` date, `is_active` boolean default false (not fillable; changed only by set-active; at most one active term, always in the active school year). Label computed, never stored: `Term::buildLabel()` → "1st Semester", "2nd Semester", "1st Trimester", "2nd Trimester", "3rd Trimester". Date rules: end strictly after start; both dates inside the year (inclusive); vs every other term of the year, a higher number starts strictly after a lower number ends (so no overlap, not even one shared day); terms may be added in any order.
- Term endpoints (mis-11, `TermController`): `term` = `TermResource` `{id, school_year_id, term_number, label, start_date, end_date, is_active, created_at, updated_at}`. `GET /api/mis/school-years/{id}/terms` (any staff: admin, registrar, cashier) → 200 `{terms: [term]}` by `term_number`, all rows; 404. `GET /api/mis/terms/get-active` (any staff: admin, registrar, cashier) → 200 `{term}` with nested `school_year`, or `{"term": null}`. Admin only: `POST /api/mis/school-years/{id}/terms` JSON `{term_number, start_date, end_date}` → 201 `{term}`; `PUT /api/mis/terms/{id}` same body → 200 `{term}`; `DELETE /api/mis/terms/{id}` → 204, 422 `{"message":"The active term cannot be deleted."}` or, for an inactive term with enrollments (mis-13), 422 `{"message":"The term has enrollments and cannot be deleted."}`; `PUT /api/mis/terms/set-active/{id}` (body-less) → 200 `{term}` (one transaction, 3 attempts), 422 `{"message":"Only a term of the active school year can be set active."}`. Write routes resolve the year/term before validation: 401 → 403 → 404 → 422. No deactivate route.
- Entity `students` (mis-4, `Student`): `lrn` string(12) unique (exactly 12 digits, validated); required `first_name`, `last_name`, `birth_date` (date, before today), `gender` (`Student::GENDERS`), `guardian_name`, `guardian_relationship`, `guardian_contact` (max 20); nullable `middle_name`, `address`, `contact` (max 20); `rfid` nullable unique and `user_id` nullable unique FK to `users` (null on delete) are not fillable and never written by the student endpoints.
- Student endpoints (mis-4, `StudentController`, registry group: admin and registrar): `student` = `StudentResource` (16 keys since mis-13, `birth_date` `Y-m-d`, `rfid` string or null, `current_enrollment` `{id, section_id, term_id, section {id, name}, grade_level {id, name, stage}}` or null, no `user_id`; `grade_level`/`section` were dropped, a student's level now comes from its current enrollment: enrolled row in a section of the active school year, whole-year or of the active term, highest id wins). `GET /api/mis/students?search=&grade_level_id=&page=` → 200 `{students: [student], meta: {current_page, last_page, per_page, total}}`, 15 per page, `created_at` desc then `id` desc, search = every whitespace-split word in lrn/first/middle/last name (case-insensitive), no `per_page` param. `POST /api/mis/students` → 201 `{student}`; `PUT /api/mis/students/{id}` → 200 `{student}` (LRN unique ignores own row); `DELETE /api/mis/students/{id}` → 204, 422 `{"message":"The student has enrollments and cannot be deleted."}` when it has any enrollment. A student with discounts (mis-17): 422 `{"message":"The student has discounts and cannot be deleted."}` (checked after the enrollments guard). 422 `{message, errors}`; 404 `{message}`; `rfid`/`user_id` in a body are ignored. Status precedence 401 → 403 → 422 → 404. A student with assessments (mis-18): 422 `{"message":"The student has assessments and cannot be deleted."}` (checked after the discounts guard).
- Entity `users` as employees (mis-5): adds `contact` string(20) nullable (fillable, max 20) and `is_active` boolean default true (not fillable; changed only by deactivate/reactivate). Inactive users cannot log in and hold no tokens.
- Employee endpoints (mis-5, `EmployeeController`, admin group): `employee` = `EmployeeResource` `{id, name, email, contact, is_active, roles: string[], created_at, updated_at}`. `GET /api/mis/employees?search=&role=&status=&page=` → 200 `{employees: [employee], meta}`, 15 per page, newest first, search = every word in name/email, `role` admin|registrar|cashier|teacher, `status` active|inactive. `POST /api/mis/employees` → 201 `{employee}` (password min 8 confirmed, roles ≥ 1 of `Role::EMPLOYEE_ROLES`, teacher added in mis-22). `PUT /api/mis/employees/{id}` → 200 `{employee}` (no password). `PUT /api/mis/employees/{id}/password` → 200 `{employee}`, revokes all its tokens. `PUT /api/mis/employees/{id}/deactivate` → 200 `{employee}`, revokes all its tokens; `/reactivate` → 200 `{employee}`. Safeguards (422): no self-deactivate, no removing your own admin role, the last active admin cannot be deactivated or lose admin. Search/page meta shared via `Concerns\SearchesPaginatedLists`.
- Entity `grade_levels` (mis-10, `GradeLevel`): `name` string unique, `sort_order` unique (1–10), `stage` `jhs`|`shs`|`college` (`GradeLevel::STAGES`; programs use `GradeLevel::PROGRAM_STAGES` = shs, college). Exactly 10 fixed rows (Grade 7–10 jhs, Grade 11–12 shs, 1st–4th Year College college; names Grade 7–10, Grade 11–12, 1st–4th Year College) inserted by the create migration itself, so they exist after `migrate` and in every test without `db:seed`. No write endpoints.
- Entity `programs` (mis-10, `Program`): `code` string(20) unique, stored upper-case (trimmed + upper-cased before validation, so uniqueness ignores case); required `name` (max 255) and `stage` (`shs`|`college`); `description` text nullable (max 1000); `is_active` boolean default true (not fillable; changed only by deactivate/reactivate). A program covers every grade level of its stage (shared stage value, no relation). The demo seeder adds STEM, ABM, HUMSS, GAS, TVL (shs) and BSIT, BSCS, BSBA (college) once each, keyed on code.
- Grade-level and program endpoints (mis-10, `GradeLevelController`, `ProgramController`): `GET /api/mis/grade-levels` (any staff: admin, registrar, cashier) → 200 `{grade_levels: [{id, name, stage, sort_order}]}`, all 10 by `sort_order`. `program` = `ProgramResource` `{id, code, name, stage, description, is_active, created_at, updated_at}`. `GET /api/mis/programs?search=&stage=&status=&page=` (any staff: admin, registrar, cashier) → 200 `{programs: [program], meta}`, 15 per page, `code` asc, search = every word in code/name, `stage` shs|college, `status` active|inactive, inactive rows listed by default. Admin only: `POST /api/mis/programs` → 201 `{program}`; `PUT /api/mis/programs/{id}` → 200 `{program}`; `PUT /api/mis/programs/{id}/deactivate` and `/reactivate` → 200 `{program}` (body-less, idempotent); `DELETE /api/mis/programs/{id}` → 204 (hard delete); 422 `{"message":"The program has sections and cannot be deleted."}` when sections use it (mis-12), or 422 `{"message":"The program has fee schedules and cannot be deleted."}` when fee schedules use it (mis-15, checked after the sections guard), or 422 `{"message":"The program has curriculum entries and cannot be deleted."}` when curriculum entries use it (mis-21, checked after the fee-schedules guard). 422 `{message, errors}`; 404 `{message}`.
- Entity `sections` (mis-12, `Section`): `school_year_id` FK, `grade_level_id` FK, `program_id` FK nullable (all three restrict on delete), `name` string (max 255, trimmed, case kept), `capacity` unsigned integer (1–2147483647), `room_id` FK nullable to `rooms` and `adviser_id` FK nullable to `users` (both restrict on delete; mis-22 replaced the `room` text, a reversible data migration turns each distinct trimmed, case-folded text into one `classroom` room spelled as on the lowest section id and aborts with a `RuntimeException` naming `#id name` when any text is over 50 characters after trimming; `down()` restores the text and keeps the rooms). An inactive room is rejected on create and when `room_id` changes, kept when unchanged. The adviser must be an active user holding the teacher role (checked on create or when it changes; an unchanged adviser who was later deactivated is kept), and one teacher advises at most one section per school year (checked whenever `adviser_id` is filled, excluding the section itself, in the request and again under a `lockForUpdate` on the school-year row inside a transaction with 3 attempts). A section lasts the whole school year (no term); its enrolled count is computed per request (mis-13). Program rules by the grade level's stage: JHS no program, SHS an SHS program, college a college program; an inactive program is rejected on create and when the program changes, kept when unchanged. Name unique ignoring case within school year + grade level + program, with "no program" one group; enforced by `StoreSectionRequest` (`LOWER(name) = LOWER(?)`), no unique index. Ids and capacity accept JSON numbers or digit strings without leading zeros.
- Section endpoints (mis-12, `SectionController`): `section` = `SectionResource` `{id, school_year_id, grade_level_id, program_id, name, capacity, room_id, adviser_id, created_at, updated_at, grade_level: {id, name, stage}, program: {id, code, name} | null, room: {id, name, building} | null, adviser: {id, name} | null, enrolled_count}` (15 keys since mis-22; the adviser shows only id and name, even when deactivated). `GET /api/mis/sections?school_year_id=&grade_level_id=&program_id=&room_id=&adviser_id=&search=&page=` (admin, registrar) → 200 `{sections: [section], meta}`, 15 per page, `school_year_id` required (422), ordered grade level `sort_order` → program code → name, search = every word in name. Admin only: `POST /api/mis/sections` → 201 `{section}`; `PUT /api/mis/sections/{id}` (full body, every field editable) → 200 `{section}`; `DELETE /api/mis/sections/{id}` → 204, 422 `{"message":"The section has enrollments and cannot be deleted."}` when it has any enrollment (mis-13), else 422 `{"message":"The section has classes and cannot be deleted."}` when it has a class (mis-23; checked after the enrollments guard, under the school-year row lock). `enrolled_count` = enrolled rows of the section; with `term_id` it counts that term plus whole-year (JHS) rows, without it every enrolled row. Once a section has enrollments (any status) its `school_year_id`, `grade_level_id` and `program_id` cannot change and `capacity` cannot drop below the largest per-term enrolled count (422 `errors.<field>`); since mis-23 the same three fields also lock once the section has classes (422 `This field cannot change once the section has classes.`; the enrollments message wins when both apply). 422 `{message, errors}` (`program_id` for stage/inactive rules, `name` for uniqueness, `room_id` "The selected room is inactive.", `adviser_id` "The adviser must be an active employee with the teacher role." or "This teacher already advises section <name> in this school year."; a `room` key in the body is ignored); 404 `{message}`. Status precedence 401 → 403 → 422 → 404.
- Entity `enrollments` (mis-13, `Enrollment`): `student_id`, `section_id` (FK restrict), `term_id` nullable (FK restrict; null for a JHS section, required for SHS/college and must belong to the section's school year), `status` (`Enrollment::STATUSES`: `enrolled`, `moved`, `dropped`, `transferred`, `completed`), `enrolled_at` date, `ended_at` date nullable (null while `enrolled`), `remarks` text nullable (max 1000). No unique index: "at most one `enrolled` row per student and period" (a JHS year row collides with any row of that school year, across stages) and the hard capacity limit (enrolled rows of the section and the same `term_id`, closed rows and other terms not counted) are checked in `EnrollmentController` under row locks (the overlap rule is `Enrollment::scopeInPeriodOf`, shared with the rollover) (student, enrollment, then section, in one transaction with 3 attempts). Status changes only from `enrolled`; there is no update or delete endpoint.
- Enrollment endpoints (mis-13, `EnrollmentController`, registry group: admin and registrar): `enrollment` = `EnrollmentResource` `{id, student_id, section_id, term_id, status, enrolled_at, ended_at, remarks, created_at, updated_at, student {id, lrn, first_name, middle_name, last_name}, section {id, name, grade_level {id, name, stage}, program {id, code} | null}, term {id, term_number, label} | null}`. `GET /api/mis/enrollments?school_year_id=&term_id=&section_id=&grade_level_id=&status=&search=&page=` → 200 `{enrollments, meta}`, 15 per page, `school_year_id` required, ordered last name → first name → id, `term_id` keeps the year's JHS rows, search = every word in lrn/first/middle/last name. `POST /api/mis/enrollments` `{student_id, section_id, term_id?, enrolled_at?, remarks?}` → 201 `{enrollment}` (`enrolled_at` defaults to today); 422 `errors.term_id` (JHS with a term / term missing / term of another year), `errors.student_id` "The student is already enrolled for this period.", `errors.section_id` "The section is full for this period.". `POST` refuses a student on hold for the section's school year with 422 `errors.hold` (`EnrollmentController::HOLD_ERROR_KEY`, message `PaymentHold::HOLD_MESSAGE_FORMAT`, checked before the period and capacity checks; skipped when the student already has an enrollment of any status in that school year; mis-20). Move/drop/transfer/complete, section Complete and rollover never check holds. `PUT /api/mis/enrollments/{id}/move` `{section_id, ended_at?, remarks?}` → 200 `{enrollment}` = the new row (same term, same school year and grade level as the source, program may differ; the source becomes `moved`); `PUT .../{id}/drop|transfer|complete` `{ended_at?, remarks?}` → 200 `{enrollment}`. `ended_at` defaults to today and may equal but not precede `enrolled_at` (`errors.ended_at`). A non-`enrolled` row gives 422 `{"message":"Only an enrolled record can be changed."}`. Precedence on `{id}` routes: 401 → 403 → 422 (body) → 404 → 422 (closed) → 422 (fields).
- Section rollover endpoints (mis-14, `SectionRolloverController`, registry group, no migration): the next term is the term of the same year with `term_number + 1` (`Term::findNextTerm()`; `Term::isLastTerm()` = number at or above `SchoolYear::TERM_COUNTS`). `GET /api/mis/sections/{id}/rollover-preview?term_id=` -> 200 `{target_term: {id, term_number, label}|null, seats_left: int|null, enrollments: [row]}` (row = `EnrollmentResource` plus `is_enrolled_in_target` and `skip_reason`, 15 keys, not paginated, last name -> first name -> id); `target_term` and `seats_left` are null when the term is the last or its next term is missing; seats left = capacity minus enrolled rows of the section in the next term. `POST /api/mis/sections/{id}/rollover` `{term_id, enrollment_ids: int[] (>=1, distinct), ended_at?, remarks?}` -> 200 `{copied_count, skipped: [row]}`: in one transaction (3 attempts, lock order student -> enrollment -> section, each batch sorted by id) each selected `enrolled` record becomes `completed` (`ended_at` defaults to today) and an `enrolled` record is opened in the same section for the next term (`enrolled_at` = `ended_at`); students already enrolled in the next term are skipped and reported, their source stays `enrolled`. Whole-batch 422s: `errors.term_id` (JHS section, term of another year, last term, next term missing), `errors.enrollment_ids` (missing, closed, other-section or other-term id), `errors.ended_at` (before an enrolled date of a record to copy), `errors.section_id` (to-copy count above seats left). `PUT /api/mis/sections/{id}/complete` `{term_id?, ended_at?, remarks?}` -> 200 `{completed_count}` closes every `enrolled` record of the section as `completed`: per term for SHS/college (`term_id` required), the whole year for JHS (`term_id` forbidden); zero rows is 200 with 0. Precedence: rollover 401 -> 403 -> 422 (body, JHS, year) -> 404 -> 422 (term, selection, date, seats); preview 401 -> 403 -> 422 -> 404; complete 401 -> 403 -> 422 -> 404 -> 422 (`ended_at`).
- Entity `fee_items` (mis-15, `FeeItem`): `name` string (max 255, trimmed, unique ignoring case; enforced by `StoreFeeItemRequest` with `LOWER(name) = LOWER(?)`, no unique index), `category` string (`FeeItem::CATEGORIES`: `tuition`, `miscellaneous`, `other`), `description` text nullable (max 1000), `is_active` boolean default true (not fillable; changed only by deactivate/reactivate). There is no delete endpoint; the restrict FK from `fee_schedule_lines` also protects a used item.
- Entities `fee_schedules` + `fee_schedule_lines` (mis-15, `FeeSchedule`, `FeeScheduleLine`): a schedule is keyed by `school_year_id`, `grade_level_id` (FK restrict) and nullable `program_id` (FK restrict; null = the grade level's default); JHS and SHS grade levels only (`FeeSchedule::BILLABLE_STAGES`, college later). JHS takes no program; an SHS program must be SHS and active. Each key exists once, with "no program" its own value; enforced by `StoreFeeScheduleRequest` and, under a lock on the school year row inside a transaction (3 attempts), again by the create and copy controllers (no unique index). `fee_schedule_lines`: `fee_schedule_id` (FK cascade), `fee_item_id` (FK restrict), `amount` decimal(12,2) > 0 with at most two decimals, unique per schedule and item. Money is exact: totals use `Brick\Math\BigDecimal` and every amount, `total` and subtotal is a 2-decimal string. Keys are locked after create. `FeeSchedule::findEffective()` (program schedule, else the default, else null) is the in-process lookup MIS-18 uses.
- Fee endpoints (mis-15, `FeeItemController`, `FeeScheduleController`, `FeeScheduleCopyController`, admin group only: registrar 403, guest 401): `fee_item` = `FeeItemResource` `{id, name, category, description, is_active, created_at, updated_at}`; `fee_schedule` = `FeeScheduleResource` `{id, school_year_id, grade_level_id, program_id, created_at, updated_at, grade_level {id, name, stage}, program {id, code, name} | null, lines_count, total, subtotals {tuition, miscellaneous, other}}`; the detail (`FeeScheduleDetailResource`) adds `lines: [{id, fee_item_id, amount, fee_item {id, name, category, is_active}}]`. `GET /api/mis/fee-items?search=&category=&status=&page=` → 200 `{fee_items, meta}` (15 per page, `name` then `id`, inactive listed by default); `POST /api/mis/fee-items` `{name, category, description?}` → 201 `{fee_item}` (422 `errors.name` "The name has already been taken."); `PUT /api/mis/fee-items/{id}` → 200 (`is_active` unchanged); `PUT .../{id}/deactivate|reactivate` (body ignored, idempotent) → 200. `GET /api/mis/fee-schedules?school_year_id=&grade_level_id=&program_id=<id>|none&page=` → 200 `{fee_schedules, meta}` (`school_year_id` required; grade level order, default first, then program code; 15 per page); `GET /api/mis/fee-schedules/{id}` → 200 `{fee_schedule: detail}`; `POST /api/mis/fee-schedules` `{school_year_id, grade_level_id, program_id|null, lines: [{fee_item_id, amount}]}` → 201 detail (lines: at least one, active item, each item once, amount > 0 with at most two decimals up to 9999999999.99; 422 `errors.grade_level_id` for a college level or a taken key, `errors.program_id` for the program rules); `PUT /api/mis/fee-schedules/{id}` `{lines}` → 200 detail, lines replaced as a set in one transaction; a key field sent with another value → 422 `errors.<field>` "This field cannot change once the fee schedule exists."; an inactive item stays only on an unchanged line (same amount); `DELETE /api/mis/fee-schedules/{id}` → 204 (lines cascade); `GET /api/mis/fee-schedules/lookup?school_year_id=&grade_level_id=&program_id=` → 200 `{fee_schedule: detail | null}`; `POST /api/mis/fee-schedules/copy` `{source_school_year_id, target_school_year_id}` → 200 `{copied_count, skipped: [{grade_level, program, reason}]}` (one transaction; Ids accept JSON numbers or digit strings. Precedence 401 → 403 → 422 → 404.
- Entities `payment_plans` + `payment_plan_installments` (mis-16, `PaymentPlan`, `PaymentPlanInstallment`): a plan belongs to a school year (`school_year_id`, FK restrict, locked after create) and has `name` (max 100, trimmed, unique per year ignoring case; enforced by `StorePaymentPlanRequest` with `LOWER(name) = LOWER(?)` and again under a lock on the school year row in a transaction with 3 attempts by the create, update and copy controllers; no unique index), `description` text nullable (max 1000), `is_active` (default true, not fillable; only deactivate/reactivate change it), a down payment (`down_payment_type` `fixed`|`percent`, `down_payment_value` decimal(12,2)) and an optional tuition-only adjustment (`adjustment_kind` `discount`|`surcharge`, `adjustment_type`, `adjustment_value`). Values are > 0 with at most two decimals; fixed up to 9999999999.99, a percent down payment < 100, a percent adjustment <= 100. `payment_plan_installments`: `payment_plan_id` (FK cascade), `sequence` (1..12), `due_date`, unique per plan on sequence and on date. A plan has 0 to 12 due dates (`due_dates` list; none = a "Cash" plan), distinct, strictly increasing and inside the school year (inclusive); an update replaces them as a set. A down payment is required with installments and refused without; a discount is allowed only on a Cash plan and a surcharge only on an installment plan. Money stays a 2-decimal string. MIS-18 reads `PaymentPlan::isCash()` and `PaymentPlan::ADJUSTMENT_CATEGORY` (`tuition`) in-process.
- Payment plan endpoints (mis-16, `PaymentPlanController`, `PaymentPlanCopyController`, plan reads (`GET /payment-plans`, `/{id}`) in the registry group since mis-18, writes admin only: registrar 403 on writes, guest 401): `payment_plan` = `PaymentPlanResource` `{id, school_year_id, name, description, is_active, installments_count, installments: [{sequence, due_date}], down_payment {type, value} | null, adjustment {kind, type, value, category} | null, created_at, updated_at}`. `GET /api/mis/payment-plans?school_year_id=&search=&status=&page=` → 200 `{payment_plans, meta}` (`school_year_id` required, `name` then `id`, 15 per page, inactive listed by default); `GET /api/mis/payment-plans/{id}` → 200 `{payment_plan}`; `POST /api/mis/payment-plans` `{school_year_id, name, description?, due_dates: [Y-m-d], down_payment: {type, value} | null, adjustment: {kind, type, value} | null}` → 201 (422 keys `name`, `due_dates`, `due_dates.N`, `down_payment`, `down_payment.type|value`, `adjustment`, `adjustment.kind|type|value`); `PUT /api/mis/payment-plans/{id}` same body, `school_year_id` optional and, if sent, must equal the stored one (422 `errors.school_year_id`), installments replaced, `is_active` unchanged → 200; `PUT .../{id}/deactivate|reactivate` (body ignored, idempotent) → 200; `DELETE /api/mis/payment-plans/{id}` → 204 (installments cascade); 422 `{"message":"The payment plan is used by a current assessment and cannot be deleted."}` while a current assessment uses it (mis-18; the delete locks the plan row, superseded assessments only lose the reference); `POST /api/mis/payment-plans/copy` `{source_school_year_id, target_school_year_id}` → 200 `{copied_count, skipped: [{name, reason}]}` (one transaction; due dates move by the whole-year difference with no overflow, so Feb 29 becomes Feb 28 when the target year has no Feb 29 and stays Feb 29 when it has; skips a name that already exists in the target (ignoring case) or a moved date outside the target year; 422 `errors.target_school_year_id` for the same year). Ids accept JSON numbers or digit strings. Precedence 401 → 403 → 422 → 404.
- Entities `discount_types` + `student_discounts` (mis-17, `DiscountType`, `StudentDiscount`): `discount_types` is a global catalog (no school year): `name` string(100) (unique ignoring case, enforced by `StoreDiscountTypeRequest` with `LOWER(name) = LOWER(?)`, no unique index, no locked re-check), `description` text nullable (max 1000), `source` `government`|`school`, `value_type` `fixed`|`percent`, `value` decimal(12,2) > 0 with at most two decimals (fixed up to 9999999999.99, percent up to 100, cast `decimal:2`), `base` `tuition`|`total`, `stages` json (cast `array`, stored in canonical order `jhs`, `shs`; non-empty, `college` refused, never queried in SQL), `is_active` boolean default true (not fillable; changed only by deactivate/reactivate). While students hold a type its `source` cannot change and no stage can be removed (adding a stage and changing name, description, value type, value and base stay allowed; inactive types stay editable). `student_discounts`: `student_id`, `school_year_id`, `discount_type_id` (all FK restrict), `reference_no` string(50) nullable, `remarks` string(500) nullable, unique (`student_id`, `school_year_id`, `discount_type_id`, index `student_discounts_assignment_unique`). An assignment needs an active type, an `enrolled` or `completed` enrollment of the student in that school year whose grade-level stage the type allows (`StudentDiscount::findEnrolledStages()`), at most one assignment per type and at most one `government` type per student per year (re-checked under a lock on the student row in a transaction with 3 attempts); held rows count whatever their type's `is_active`. Update changes only `reference_no` and `remarks`; delete is always allowed. Stacking rule for MIS-18: every discount is computed on the gross amount of its base, the discounts are summed, and the total discount is capped so no category goes below ₱0.
- Discount endpoints (mis-17, `DiscountTypeController`, `StudentDiscountController`, admin group only: registrar 403, guest 401): `discount_type` = `DiscountTypeResource` `{id, name, description, source, value_type, value, base, stages, is_active, created_at, updated_at}`; `student_discount` = `StudentDiscountResource` `{id, student_id, school_year_id, discount_type_id, reference_no, remarks, created_at, updated_at, student {id, lrn, first_name, middle_name, last_name}, grade_level {id, name, stage} | null, discount_type {id, name, source, value_type, value, base, is_active}}` (`grade_level` = the student's latest enrollment in that row's year). `GET /api/mis/discount-types?search=&source=&status=&page=` → 200 `{discount_types, meta}` (15 per page, `name` then `id`, inactive listed by default); `GET /api/mis/discount-types/{id}` → 200 `{discount_type}`; `POST /api/mis/discount-types` `{name, description?, source, value_type, value, base, stages: ["jhs"|"shs"]}` → 201 (422 `errors.name`, `description`, `source`, `value_type`, `value`, `base`, `stages`, `stages.N` including "Discount types are only for junior and senior high school." for `college`); `PUT /api/mis/discount-types/{id}` same body → 200 (`is_active` unchanged; held type: 422 `errors.source` "The source cannot change while students hold this discount type." / `errors.stages` "A stage cannot be removed while students hold this discount type."); `PUT .../{id}/deactivate|reactivate` (body ignored, idempotent) → 200; `DELETE /api/mis/discount-types/{id}` → 204, 422 `{"message":"The discount type is held by students and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead."}` while any student holds it. `GET /api/mis/student-discounts?school_year_id=&search=&discount_type_id=&source=&student_id=&page=` → 200 `{student_discounts, meta}` (`school_year_id` required, student last name → first name → id, 15 per page); `POST /api/mis/student-discounts` `{student_id, school_year_id, discount_type_id, reference_no?, remarks?}` → 201 (422 `errors.student_id` not enrolled, `errors.discount_type_id` first failure of inactive / stage not allowed / already held / government limit); `PUT /api/mis/student-discounts/{id}` `{reference_no?, remarks?}` (other keys ignored) → 200; `DELETE /api/mis/student-discounts/{id}` → 204 (mis-18 guard: while the student has a current assessment for the year, add and delete answer 422 `errors.assessment` "The student has a current assessment for this school year. Confirm to re-assess it with its payment plan." and write nothing; with `reassess` (`POST` body boolean, `DELETE ?reassess=1`, boolean rule on both) the change and a re-assessment with the same plan run in one transaction under the student-row lock, 422 `errors.reassess` when that plan is inactive or deleted ("The payment plan of the current assessment is inactive. Re-assess the student with an active plan first.") or when the student is no longer assessable (the eligibility message), and any 422 rolls the discount change back; success responses unchanged; superseded assessments never guard). While the current assessment has non-voided payments, add/remove → 422 `errors.reassess` `Assessment::HAS_PAYMENTS_MESSAGE` before the confirm check (mis-19). Ids accept JSON numbers or digit strings. Precedence 401 → 403 → 422 → 404.
- Entities `assessments` + `assessment_fee_lines` + `assessment_discounts` + `assessment_installments` (mis-18, `Assessment`, `AssessmentFeeLine`, `AssessmentDiscount`, `AssessmentInstallment`, `App\Support\AssessmentCalculator`, `App\Support\PaymentScheduleBuilder`): an assessment is one student's frozen statement for one school year. `assessments`: `student_id`, `school_year_id`, `grade_level_id` (FK restrict), `program_id` nullable (restrict), `payment_plan_id` nullable (FK null on delete), `status` `current`|`superseded` (`Assessment::STATUSES`; at most one `current` row per student and year, no unique index: checked by `StoreAssessmentRequest` and re-checked under the student-row lock), `plan_name` and the adjustment snapshot (`adjustment_kind|type|value`, `adjustment_amount` >= 0 with the sign given by the kind), `gross_tuition|miscellaneous|other|total`, `discount_tuition|miscellaneous|other|total`, `net_total` (all `decimal(14,2)`, strings in JSON), `created_by` / `superseded_by` nullable FK to `users` (null on delete), `superseded_at`. Children (cascade): `assessment_fee_lines` (`fee_item_name`, `category`, `amount`), `assessment_discounts` (`discount_type_name`, `source`, `value_type`, `value`, `base`, `reference_no`, `computed_amount`, `applied_amount`), `assessment_installments` (`sequence`, `label`, `due_date`, `amount`; unique per assessment and sequence); no FK to catalog rows, so later setup edits never change a snapshot. Source enrollment (D4): the student's `enrolled` or `completed` enrollments of the year in a JHS/SHS grade level, `enrolled` first, then newest id (`Assessment::pickSourceEnrollment`, `Enrollment::scopeEligibleForAssessment`); its section gives the grade level and program, and `FeeSchedule::findEffective()` the schedule (inactive items are billed). Discounts (D7): every student discount of the year with its type (even inactive), fixed value or percent of the gross base (`HALF_UP`, 2 places); tuition-based ones are capped at gross tuition, total-based ones at the rest, the excess cut in trim order (government source first, then type name, then id; applied vs computed kept per row); the total-based amount fills tuition, then miscellaneous, then other. Plan adjustment (D8): on gross tuition minus the tuition discounts; a `discount` is capped at that base, a `surcharge` is added; net total is never below 0.00. Schedule (D9): cash = one `Full payment` row due today; installments = `Down payment` due today (fixed capped at net, or percent of net) then `Installment 1..n` on the plan due dates, equal shares with the last absorbing the cents (rounding down when a tiny balance would make the last negative). Money is `BigDecimal` only. Plain Model plus `Support/` classes; the calculator throws `ValidationException` (`student_id`, `payment_plan_id`) when ineligible.
- Assessment endpoints (mis-18, `AssessmentController`, `AssessmentCandidateController`, list/show/history in the billing-read group (+ cashier), preview/create/reassess/candidates in the registry group (admin and registrar), guest 401, other roles 403; `ListAssessmentsRequest`, `ListAssessmentCandidatesRequest`, `PreviewAssessmentRequest`, `StoreAssessmentRequest`, `ReassessAssessmentRequest`; resources `AssessmentResource` (27 keys stored: + `total_paid`, `balance`, `has_payments`; 24 in a preview, where `id`, `status`, `created_at`, `superseded_at`, `superseded_by` are null), `AssessmentRowResource` (13 keys), `AssessmentCandidateResource` (7 keys)): `GET /api/mis/assessments?school_year_id=&search=&grade_level_id=&payment_plan_id=&page=` -> 200 `{assessments: [assessment_row], meta}` (current rows only, by student name, 15 per page); `GET /api/mis/assessments/candidates?school_year_id=&search=&page=` -> 200 `{students: [candidate], meta}` (enrolled/completed JHS/SHS students of the year without a current assessment); `POST /api/mis/assessments/preview` `{student_id, school_year_id, payment_plan_id}` -> 200 `{assessment}`, nothing written; `POST /api/mis/assessments` same body -> 201 `{assessment}` (transaction with 3 attempts under the student-row lock, plan row re-read under lock); `GET /api/mis/assessments/{id}` -> 200; `GET /api/mis/assessments/{id}/history` -> 200 `{assessments: [assessment_row]}` (same student and year, id desc); `POST /api/mis/assessments/{id}/reassess` `{payment_plan_id}` -> 201 `{assessment}` (the old row becomes `superseded` with `superseded_at` / `superseded_by`), 422 `{"message":"Only the current assessment can be re-assessed."}` for a superseded row, then 422 `errors.reassess` `Assessment::HAS_PAYMENTS_MESSAGE` while the current assessment has non-voided payments (mis-19). 422 `{message, errors}` keys: `student_id` (not enrolled, only JHS/SHS can be assessed, no fee schedule for the grade level and program, already has a current assessment on create), `payment_plan_id` (other year, inactive). No update or delete route (405). Ids numeric (`whereNumber`), precedence 401 -> 403 -> 422 -> 404.
- Entities `payments` + `receipt_counters` (mis-19, `Payment`, `App\Support\PaymentAllocation`, `App\Support\ReceiptNumberAllocator`): `payments` = `assessment_id`, `student_id`, `school_year_id` (all restrict FKs, student and year denormalised), unique `ar_number` (`AR-000001`, `Payment::AR_NUMBER_FORMAT`), `amount` / `balance_after` decimal(14,2) (`balance_after` is a snapshot, never rewritten), `payment_date`, `method` (`Payment::METHODS`), `reference_no` (required unless cash), `remarks`, `recorded_by`, nullable `voided_at` / `voided_by` / `void_reason` (restrict FKs; payments are never edited or deleted, only voided); `receipt_counters` = one row per `series` with `last_number`. AR series (D4): `ReceiptNumberAllocator::allocateNext()` runs inside the record transaction (`insertOrIgnore` the series row, lock it, increment), so a rollback releases the number and the series never skips or repeats. Void permission (D7): `Payment::isVoidPermittedFor()` is true for an admin, and for a cashier only on a payment they recorded on the same Manila day; resources expose `can_void`. Allocation (D8): `PaymentAllocation` (BigDecimal only) fills the installment schedule oldest due first from the non-voided total, derived on every read; a row is `paid` / `partial` / `unpaid`, `is_overdue` = due date strictly before today and not paid. `Assessment` gains `payments()`, `hasValidPayments()`, `calculateTotalPaid()`, `calculateBalance()`.
- Payment endpoints (mis-19, `PaymentController`; requests `ListPaymentsRequest`, `StorePaymentRequest`, `VoidPaymentRequest`, `ShowPaymentLedgerRequest`; resources `PaymentResource` (18 keys), `PaymentReceiptResource` (21 keys), `PaymentLedgerResource` (13 keys: `assessment_id`, `student`, `school_year`, `grade_level`, `program`, `plan_name`, `net_total`, `total_paid`, `balance`, `next_amount_due`, `schedule`, `payments`, `promissory_notes`)): amounts are 2-decimal strings. `GET /api/mis/payments?date_from=&date_to=&method=&recorded_by=&status=&search=&page=` (billing-read group) → 200 `{payments, meta, collection_total}`, dates default to today and are inclusive on `payment_date`, 15 per page, `payment_date` desc then id desc, `collection_total` = non-voided amounts of the whole filter. `POST /api/mis/payments` `{assessment_id, amount, payment_date?, method, reference_no?, remarks?}` (payment-write group) → 201 `{payment}`; transaction with 3 attempts, lock order student → assessment → counter; 422 `errors.assessment_id` `PaymentController::SUPERSEDED_MESSAGE`, 422 `errors.amount` `PaymentController::OVERPAYMENT_MESSAGE`, 422 `errors.reference_no` `StorePaymentRequest::REFERENCE_REQUIRED_MESSAGE`. `PUT /api/mis/payments/{id}/void` `{void_reason}` → 200 `{payment}`; 403 `{message: VOID_NOT_ALLOWED_MESSAGE}` (after the 404), 422 `errors.payment` `ALREADY_VOIDED_MESSAGE`. `GET /api/mis/payments/{id}/receipt` → 200 `{receipt}`; `GET /api/mis/payments/ledger?student_id=&school_year_id=` → 200 `{ledger}` of the current assessment, 404 `{message: NO_CURRENT_ASSESSMENT_MESSAGE}`; `GET /api/mis/payments/recorders` → 200 `{recorders: [{id, name}]}` (admin and cashier holders, active or not, by name). Reads: admin, registrar, cashier; writes: admin, cashier (registrar 403). No edit or delete route. Precedence 401 → 403 → 422 → 404.
- Entity `promissory_notes` (mis-20, `PromissoryNote`, `App\Support\PaymentHold`, `App\Support\PaymentHoldList`): `student_id`, `school_year_id` (the balance year; FK restrict, indexed pair), `promised_amount` decimal(14,2), `promise_date` date, `remarks` string(500) nullable, `granted_by` (FK restrict; granted at = `created_at`), nullable `cancelled_at` / `cancelled_by` (FK restrict) / `cancel_reason`; fillable `promised_amount`, `promise_date`, `remarks`, the rest `forceFill`ed. A note is keyed by student and year, not by assessment, so it survives a re-assess; notes are never edited or deleted, only cancelled, and no hold and no status are stored. Hold rule (`PaymentHold`): a student is on hold for target year X when a current assessment of an earlier-starting school year has a balance above zero and no active note, unless the student already has an enrollment of any status in a section of X. Active note: not cancelled and `promise_date` on or after the Manila today (`PromissoryNote::scopeActive`, `isActive()`). Status derived on read, precedence cancelled, settled (year balance 0 or less), active, broken (`PromissoryNote::deriveStatus()` after `assignYearBalance()`).
- Payment hold endpoints (mis-20, `PaymentHoldController`, `PromissoryNoteController`; requests `CheckPaymentHoldRequest`, `ListPaymentHoldsRequest`, `StorePromissoryNoteRequest`, `CancelPromissoryNoteRequest`; resources `PromissoryNoteResource` (14 keys), `PaymentHoldResource` (4 keys), `PaymentHoldRowResource` (7 keys)): amounts are 2-decimal strings. Billing-read group (admin, registrar, cashier): `GET /api/mis/payment-holds/check?student_id=&school_year_id=` → 200 `{hold: {student_id, school_year_id, on_hold, unpaid_years: [{school_year, net_total, total_paid, balance, active_note}]}}` (earlier unpaid years oldest first); `GET /api/mis/payment-holds?status=&school_year_id=&search=&page=` → 200 `{payment_holds: [row], meta}`, one row per student and school year (every unpaid current assessment plus every pair with a note, newest note shown, `note_status` none|active|broken|settled|cancelled), 15 per page, last name → first name → student id → year start descending. Payment-write group (admin, cashier; registrar 403): `POST /api/mis/promissory-notes` `{student_id, school_year_id, promised_amount, promise_date, remarks?}` → 201 `{promissory_note}` (422 `promise_date` before today; 422 `school_year_id` `PromissoryNoteController::NO_BALANCE_MESSAGE` without a current assessment balance; 422 `promised_amount` `EXCEEDS_BALANCE_MESSAGE` above the balance, equal allowed; 422 `school_year_id` `ACTIVE_NOTE_EXISTS_MESSAGE`); `PUT /api/mis/promissory-notes/{id}/cancel` `{cancel_reason}` → 200 `{promissory_note}` (422 `promissory_note` `ALREADY_CANCELLED_MESSAGE`). Create and cancel run in a transaction (3 attempts) under the student-row lock shared with payments, re-assess and enrollment. The ledger (`GET /payments/ledger`) appends that student and year's notes, newest first. 422 on a refused `POST /enrollments` is `errors.hold` (see the enrollment endpoints).

JHS and SHS grade levels only (`CurriculumEntry::CURRICULUM_STAGES`). The five key fields (`KEY_FIELDS`) are unique per entry, with nulls compared as IS NULL; there is no unique index (a non-unique 4-column index only, named `curriculum_entries_group_index` because the generated name is over MySQL's 64-character limit), so `StoreCurriculumEntryRequest` and the locked re-check in `CurriculumEntryController` enforce it.

`GET /subjects/active` → 200 `{subjects}`, all active, no `meta`; `POST /subjects` `{code, name, type, weekly_hours, description?}` → 201 `{subject}` (`is_active` ignored); `PUT /subjects/{id}` same body (own code ignored in the uniqueness check) → 200; `PUT /subjects/{id}/deactivate|reactivate` → 200 `{subject}` (idempotent); no DELETE route (405). `curriculum_entry` = `CurriculumEntryResource` `{id, school_year_id, grade_level_id, subject_id, program_id, term_number, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, subject {id, code, name, type, weekly_hours, is_active}, grade_level {id, name, stage}, program {id, code, name} | null}`. `GET /curriculum-entries?school_year_id=&grade_level_id=&program_id=&term_number=` (`school_year_id` required) → 200 `{curriculum_entries, group_totals: [{grade_level_id, program_id, term_number, entries_count, weekly_hours_total}]}`, unpaginated, ordered by grade level, no-program first then program code, term, `sort_order` nulls last, id; totals are computed in PHP with `BigDecimal` (scale 1, strings) per group of the filtered rows. `POST /curriculum-entries` `{school_year_id, grade_level_id, subject_id, program_id?, term_number?, sort_order?}` → 201 `{curriculum_entry}`; 422 `grade_level_id` (college), `subject_id` (inactive, type does not match the stage, key already taken), `program_id` (JHS forbids, SHS requires an active SHS program), `term_number` (JHS forbids, SHS requires 1..N); the add runs in a transaction with a `lockForUpdate` on the school-year row and re-checks the key. `PUT /curriculum-entries/{id}` takes only `{sort_order}` (key required, null clears, everything else ignored) → 200; `DELETE /curriculum-entries/{id}` → 204 (hard delete); `POST /curriculum-entries/copy` `{source_school_year_id, target_school_year_id}` (registered before the `{id}` routes) → 200 `{copied_count, skipped_count, skipped: [{subject, grade_level, program, term_number, reason}]}`, skips inactive subjects, inactive programs and terms missing in the target term type (in that order), keeps `sort_order`; 422 `target_school_year_id` for the same year (wins) or a non-empty target (re-checked under the target-year lock). Changing a subject's `type` while it is in a curriculum is not guarded (accepted). Since mis-23 `DELETE /curriculum-entries/{id}` also answers 422 `{"message":"The curriculum entry is used by a class and cannot be deleted."}` when a class uses the entry (checked under the school-year row lock).
- Entity `rooms` (mis-22, `Room`): a global catalog, never deleted (no delete route): `name` string(50) (trimmed, unique ignoring case; enforced by `StoreRoomRequest` with `LOWER(name) = LOWER(?)`, no unique index), `building` string(100) nullable, `capacity` unsigned integer nullable (1–2147483647), `type` string (`Room::TYPES`: `classroom`, `laboratory`, `other`; no DB enum), `is_active` boolean default true (not fillable; changed only by deactivate/reactivate).
- Room and teacher endpoints (mis-22, `RoomController`, `TeacherController`; reads admin and registrar, room writes admin only; status precedence 401, 403, 422, 404): `room` = `RoomResource` `{id, name, building, capacity, type, is_active, created_at, updated_at}`; `teacher` = `TeacherResource` `{id, name, email, contact}` (active user holding the teacher role, whatever other roles: `User::scopeActiveTeachers`). `GET /api/mis/rooms?search=&type=&status=&page=` → 200 `{rooms, meta}` 15 per page, name then id, search = every word in name or building, inactive included unless filtered; `GET /rooms/active` → 200 `{rooms}`, active only, no `meta`; `POST /rooms` `{name, building?, capacity?, type}` → 201 `{room}` (`is_active` ignored); `PUT /rooms/{id}` → 200; `PUT /rooms/{id}/deactivate` and `/reactivate` → 200 (idempotent). `GET /api/mis/teachers?search=&page=` → 200 `{teachers, meta}` 15 per page, name then id, search over name only; `GET /teachers/active` → 200 `{teachers}`, no `meta`.
- Entities `classes` + `class_meetings` (mis-23, `SchoolClass`, `ClassMeeting`; `SchoolClass` because `class` is reserved, `protected $table = 'classes'`): `classes` = `section_id`, `curriculum_entry_id`, `teacher_id` (→ `users`), `school_year_id` (all restrict FKs), `term_number` unsigned tiny integer nullable, timestamps; `school_year_id` (from the section) and `term_number` (from the entry) are copied at create, not fillable and never change, because section and entry are fixed after create and a section's year/grade level/program lock once it has classes. Indexes `classes_period_index` (`school_year_id`, `term_number`) and `classes_section_entry_index` (`section_id`, `curriculum_entry_id`), the latter not unique: one class per (section, entry) is enforced by `StoreSchoolClassRequest` and re-checked under the lock. `class_meetings` = `class_id` (cascade FK), `day` unsigned tiny integer 1-6 (Mon=1 … Sat=6, `ClassMeeting::DAY_LABELS`), `start_minutes` / `end_minutes` unsigned small integers (minutes since midnight; the API speaks `HH:MM`), `room_id` nullable (restrict FK), timestamps; index `class_meetings_day_start_index`. School day 06:00-18:00 inclusive on a 5-minute step (`ClassMeeting::SCHOOL_DAY_START`, `SCHOOL_DAY_END`, `MINUTE_STEP`). No room or employee delete route exists, so the restrict FKs cannot be hit over HTTP.
- Class schedule endpoints (mis-23, `SchoolClassController`, `TimetableController`, `ScheduleConflictFinder`; all in the registry group: admin, registrar; status precedence 401, 403, 422, 404): `class` = `SchoolClassResource` `{id, section_id, curriculum_entry_id, teacher_id, school_year_id, term_number | null, created_at, updated_at, section: {id, name}, subject: {id, code, name}, teacher: {id, name}, meetings: [meeting] (day, start, id order), required_weekly_hours "4.00", scheduled_weekly_minutes (int), scheduled_weekly_hours "3.92", hours_status "under" | "exact" | "over"}` (16 keys); `meeting` = `{id, day, start_time "HH:MM", end_time "HH:MM", room_id, room: {id, name, building} | null}`. `POST /api/mis/classes` `{section_id, curriculum_entry_id, teacher_id, meetings: [{day, start_time, end_time, room_id?}]}` → 201 `{class}`; `GET /classes/{id}` → 200; `PUT /classes/{id}` `{teacher_id, meetings}` (`section_id` / `curriculum_entry_id` optional, must equal the stored ones, else 422 `This field cannot change once the class exists.`) → 200 with the meetings replaced as a set; `DELETE /classes/{id}` → 204 (meetings cascade). No separate meeting endpoints. Meetings are saved with the class, in one transaction that first locks the school-year row (`lockForUpdate`), re-checks the duplicate class and runs every conflict query before writing, so competing saves of a school year serialize; the section and curriculum-entry deletes take the same lock. Entry rules (create only): same school year, same grade level and same program as the section (422 `curriculum_entry_id`), a non-JHS/SHS section 422 `section_id`, a second class for the entry 422 `curriculum_entry_id`. Teacher must be `User::activeTeachers()` on create and when changed; an unchanged deactivated or role-less teacher is kept. A meeting with `room_id` null takes the section's room at save (null only when the section has none); an inactive effective room is 422 `meetings.{i}.room_id` unless the class already stores a meeting in that room. Errors are keyed `meetings.{i}.<field>`; overlapping meetings of one payload are 422 `meetings.{i}` on the later one. Conflicts (`ScheduleConflictFinder`): another class of the same school year with a meeting on the same day whose times strictly overlap (touching never clashes), in an overlapping period (a null term overlaps every term, else equal terms), and the same teacher, the same section or the same non-null room; the class's own stored meetings are excluded. 422 `meetings.{i}` `<Teacher|Room|Section> conflict: <section> <subject code> meets on <Day> HH:MM-HH:MM.` (precedence teacher, room, section; every clashing index in one 422; nothing is written). Hours (`SchoolClass::deriveHoursStatus`): required minutes = subject `weekly_hours` × 60, scheduled = sum of meeting minutes; never validated. Timetables: `GET /sections/{id}/timetable?term_number=` (SHS requires `term_number` 1..term count; JHS/college refuse it) → 200 `{section: {id, name, stage}, term_number, subjects: [{curriculum_entry_id, sort_order, subject: {id, code, name, type, weekly_hours}, class: class | null}]}` in curriculum order; `GET /teachers/{id}/timetable` and `GET /rooms/{id}/timetable` with `school_year_id` (required) and `term_number` (optional; given → that term plus whole-year classes, omitted → the whole year) → 200 `{meetings: [{id, day, start_time, end_time, room: {id, name, building} | null, class: {id, term_number, section: {id, name}, subject: {id, code, name}, teacher: {id, name}}}]}` in day, start, id order; the teacher id is any user, so a deactivated teacher's week stays readable. Known accepted limits: a meeting out of the school day on both start and end reports only on `end_time`; a section edit racing the first class create is not locked (the section request checks classes before the lock).
- Roles: `roles` + `role_user` pivot (many-to-many); names are `Role::ADMIN` / `Role::REGISTRAR` / `Role::CASHIER` (mis-19) / `Role::TEACHER` (mis-22) constants. `Role::EMPLOYEE_ROLES` (admin, registrar, cashier, teacher; mis-22) drives the employee `roles.*` and `role` filter rules, the seeder (4 roles, no demo teacher) and the session group; a teacher is in no other group. Lists: `Role::STAFF_ROLES` (admin, registrar, cashier; any-staff routes, employee roles), `REGISTRY_ROLES` (admin, registrar), `BILLING_READ_ROLES` (admin, registrar, cashier; separate from `STAFF_ROLES` so a later staff role gets no billing reads by default), `PAYMENT_WRITE_ROLES` (admin, cashier; also the recorders list). Since mis-21 the any-staff group (`STAFF_ROLES`) also holds `GET /subjects`, `GET /subjects/active` and `GET /curriculum-entries`, and the registry group (`REGISTRY_ROLES`) holds the 8 subject and curriculum writes. `User::hasAnyRole()` queries the roles each call; `User::hasRole()` checks the loaded `roles` relation (one query per request user, used per row for `can_void`).
- Middleware: `role:` alias → `RoleMiddleware` (any-match, 403 `{message}`); `ForceJsonResponse` prepended to the api group in `bootstrap/app.php` (built in mis-1).
- Errors are always JSON; validation via FormRequest or `$request->validate()`; list endpoints `paginate()`, except `GET /api/mis/school-years` (all rows, decided mis-3 AMBIGUITY-5); the students list pages 15 per page under a `meta` key (mis-4); the employees list does the same (mis-5), and so does the programs list (mis-10), the sections list (mis-12) the enrollments list (mis-13), the fee items and fee schedules lists (mis-15), the payment plans list (mis-16), the discount types and student discounts lists (mis-17), the assessments and assessment candidates lists (mis-18), the payments list (mis-19, `collection_total`), the subjects list (mis-21, 15 per page), the rooms and teachers lists (mis-22, 15 per page; `GET /api/mis/rooms/active` and `/teachers/active` are unpaginated); `GET /api/mis/curriculum-entries` and `GET /api/mis/subjects/active` are unpaginated (mis-21, D9/D10: the add picker and the group totals need every row); `GET /api/mis/grade-levels` returns all rows (mis-10).

## Work Guidance

- Run: `php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8000` · Test: `php artisan test` · Lint: `./vendor/bin/pint`
- Ports: 8000
- Migrate `php artisan migrate` · routes `php artisan route:list` · full dev stack `composer run dev` · first-time setup `composer run setup`
- Create files with `php artisan make:*`; controllers stay thin; no logic in route closures; config via `config()`, never `env()` outside `config/`.
- Every new endpoint gets a Feature test (success + validation failure). Scanner endpoints are tested with the firmware encoding and no Accept header. Avoid Postgres-only SQL (tests run on SQLite).
- `db:seed` needs `SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL` / `SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD` in `.env` (read via `config('auth.seed_admin.*')`); seeds roles + one admin, the demo cashier `cashier@example.com` (`firstOrCreate`, mis-19), the demo programs and six demo discount types (placeholder values, mis-17); idempotent.
- App time zone is `Asia/Manila` (mis-19): `today()` and the cashier same-day void use Manila days; JSON timestamps still serialise as UTC ISO-8601.
- Keep Laravel's unused frontend scaffolding (`resources/`, `vite.config.js`, `package.json`, `welcome` view).

## Verification

- `php artisan test` passes
- `be-auditor` passes on staged changes before commit

## Child DOX Index

- `app/` — models (`Models/`), HTTP controllers/requests/resources (`Http/`), middleware (`Http/Middleware`), plain support classes (`Support/`, the assessment calculator and the class schedule conflict finder `ScheduleConflictFinder`), providers
- `bootstrap/app.php` — routing (web, api, `/up`), middleware, exception hooks
- `config/` — framework config, including `sanctum.php`
- `database/` — migrations, factories, seeders
- `routes/` — `api.php` (all API routes), `web.php`, `console.php`
- `tests/` — `Feature/` (HTTP endpoints), `Unit/` (pure logic)
- `resources/`, `public/` — unused frontend scaffolding / entry point

# DOX framework

AGENTS.md files are binding work contracts for their subtrees. Before editing, read this file plus every AGENTS.md on the path to each file you'll touch; the nearest one is the local contract. After a meaningful change, update the closest owning AGENTS.md if purpose, structure, contracts, routes, entities, or workflows changed, and remove stale text. Create a child AGENTS.md when a folder becomes a durable boundary. Child sections: Purpose · Ownership · Local Contracts · Work Guidance · Verification · Child DOX Index.
